in DMSO (5 mL)

a  stirred  solution  of  4,6,7-trimethoxyquinazoline  1i  (110  mg,  0.5  mmol),  concentrated  H2SO4 (54 μL, 1.0 mmol), 3-iodooxetane (183 mg, 1.0 mmol) and iron(II) sulfate heptahydrate (42 mg, 0.15 mmol) in DMSO (5 mL) at 60 °C
H2O2 (30% in H2O; 153 μL, 1.50 mmol) was added dropwise
After 1-2 min
a further portion of iron(II) sulfate heptahydrate (42 mg, 0.15 mmol) was added
the mixture was stirred at 60 °C for 30 min
Further H2O2 (153 μL, 1.5 mmol)
iron(II) sulfate heptahydrate (42 mg, 0.15 mmol) was added
the mixture was stirred at  60  °C  for  a  further  60  min
Ater  allowing  to  cool
a  0.2  M  solution  of  NaOH  (50  mL)
Et2O  (30  mL)
the  mixture  was  poured  into  a  0.2  M  solution  of  NaOH  (50  mL)  and  Et2O  (30  mL)
The  aqueous  and  organic  layers  were  partitioned
the  aqueous  layer  was  saturated  with  solid  NaCl
then  extracted  with  Et2O  (2  x  25  mL)
then  extracted  with  Et2O  (2  x  25  mL)
then  extracted  with  Et2O  (2  x  25  mL)
then  extracted  with  Et2O  (2  x  25  mL)
dried (MgSO4)
filtered
the solvent removed under vacuum to leave a crude oil
The oil  was  purified  by  preparative  thin-layer  chromatography

An  analytical  sample  of  the  product  2i  (83%  purity)  was  purified  further  by  perparative  high-performance  liquid  chromatography  to  give  material  for  data  purposes  (column:  Gemini C6P (phenyl hexyl); size: 100 x 21.2 mm; particle size: 5 μM; eluent: 3-70% CH3CN in 10 mM aqueous  Et2NH; run time: 20 min; detection: UV at 254 nM; retention time: 7.76 min)
